findings.root_cause: Simulator was configured with respiration rate = 30 bpm instead of 15 bpm. Node-B correctly calculated RR = 30.0 rpm. Supervisor requires RR in [14, 16] to confirm pre-warmup baseline readiness before writing T0.json. Because RR was 30.0 != [14, 16], T0 was never established and supervisor timed out at 60s (COMMON_READY_DEADLINE).
findings.correction: Set SKX simulator menu: 呼吸率 = 15 bpm (波形周期 remains 30 bpm, 阻抗 1.5R, 窒息 0s).
